metrics.falseBlock: admitted benign operation rejected by the governance layer / all benign operations
metrics.missedConflict: oracle-labelled conflicting operations admitted concurrently / all oracle-labelled conflicts
metrics.humanMinutes: wall-clock human intervention intervals recorded in raw event log
metrics.tokens: provider-reported token count retained as raw telemetry; unavailable values remain unavailable
metrics.billedCost: provider invoice or API cost telemetry retained as raw telemetry; unavailable values remain unavailable
metrics.completion: oracle-adjudicated successful task completion / assigned tasks
metrics.retries: count of explicit rerun attempts after a nonzero or rejected attempt
metrics.repairTime: raw timestamp from first failed attempt to oracle-accepted repair
